Title: Sudden Hearing Loss, could loud headphones or high blood pressure put you at risk? - Noise, Blood Pressure, and the 72-Hour Window

Description:
Loud noise exposure, cardiovascular risk factors like high blood pressure and diabetes, and simply waiting it out all raise the risk of sudden sensorineural hearing loss. If one ear suddenly feels muffled or you notice ringing or dizziness, see a doctor as soon as possible, ideally the same day. Treatment within 72 hours gives you the best chance of recovery.

Could loud headphones or high blood pressure be putting your ears at risk? 🤔

Loud headphone use, high blood pressure and diabetes, and waiting it out all raise the risk of sudden hearing loss. Keep headphone volume moderate, stay on top of your checkups, and if you suspect sudden hearing loss, see a doctor the same day if you can.
